messages.subject: [adegenet-forum] adegenet 2.1.5 will be released soon
messages.body_plain:
Hello all,

I will be releasing adegenet 2.1.5 to CRAN within the next week
(hopefully). This update contains a few changes:

1. spdep is no longer a strict dependency, so it will be easier to install
on university clusters that do not use spatial tools in R.
2. any function that has the option to use parallel processing will default
to FALSE
3. a bug in hybridize (which was found in the tab method for genpop
objects) has been fixed.
4. the tutorials have been updated to replace the long-defunct function
pairwise.fst() with genet.dist().

If you want to try out the development version of adegenet, you can use the
following command to install it:

install.packages("adegenet", repos = "https://zkamvar.r-universe.dev")

All the best,
Zhian
